fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of net sales at steady state, with a new restaurant incentive ramp: 0% for the first two full months, 3% from months 3-10, 4% from months 11-22, and 5% from month 23 through end of initial term. Incentive applies only to newly developed Restaurants (not transfers or renewals) that meet compliance conditions. Advertising fee is 5% of net sales for all Restaurants, including Co-Brand Restaurants. Net sales exclude local and state sales taxes. Other notable fees: late interest at lesser of 18% per annum or max legal rate; transfer fee $5,000 per Franchise Agreement; renewal fee 10% of then-current initial franchise fee; audit costs plus 18% interest if understatement ≥2%; processing fee $100 plus admin expenses for NSF/insufficient funds; additional on-site training $200/day; management training course up to $500/person/day (currently $200); insurance estimate $4,000-$10,000.

Royalty Fee 1, 3 | 5% of net sales, subject to the following incentives for new Restaurants only: 1. No royalty from the day the Restaurant opens for business to the public through the end of the Restaurant's second full month of operation. 2. 3% of net sales from the Restaurant's third full month of operation through the Restaurant's tenth full month of operation. 3. 4% of net sales from the Restaurant's eleventh full month of operation through the Restaurant's twenty-second full month of operation. 4. 5% of net sales from the Restaurant's twenty-third full month of operation through the end of the initial term of the Franchise Agreement.
Advertising Fee 1, 2, 3 | 5% of net sales for all Restaurants, and 5% of net sales for franchisees of Co-Brand Restaurants.
